sources.title: Validate domain ownership for AWS Certificate Manager public certificates

en.summary: Creates, stores and renews public and private SSL/TLS certificates that protect your AWS websites and applications. You can issue certificates in ACM or import third-party ones, including wildcard certificates for many subdomains.
examCues: Get a free public TLS certificate for a load balancer or a CloudFront distribution → Certificate Manager
Stop renewing HTTPS certificates by hand → Certificate Manager
Protect every subdomain of a domain with one certificate → Certificate Manager (wildcard certificate)
Use an ACM certificate on a CloudFront distribution → Certificate Manager (request or import it in US East (N. Virginia))

notToConfuseWith.difference: KMS manages encryption keys for your data; ACM manages the TLS certificates that secure connections.
Secrets Manager stores secrets such as passwords; AWS recommends ACM for certificates and their private keys.

en.pricingModel: There is no additional charge for the SSL/TLS certificates you manage with ACM; you pay for the AWS resources that run your website or application.

aws: Issues, stores and renews certificates for integrated AWS services
customer: Proves it owns or controls each domain of a public certificate, by DNS, email or HTTP validation
Attaches certificates to the right resources and renews imported ones

es.summary: Crea, guarda y renueva certificados SSL/TLS públicos y privados que protegen tus sitios y aplicaciones en AWS. Puedes emitir certificados en ACM o importar los de terceros, incluidos certificados wildcard para muchos subdominios.
examCues: Obtener un certificado TLS público gratis para un load balancer o una distribución de CloudFront → Certificate Manager
Dejar de renovar a mano los certificados HTTPS → Certificate Manager
Proteger todos los subdominios de un dominio con un solo certificado → Certificate Manager (certificado wildcard)
Usar un certificado de ACM en una distribución de CloudFront → Certificate Manager (pedirlo o importarlo en US East (N. Virginia))

notToConfuseWith.difference: KMS administra llaves de cifrado para tus datos; ACM administra los certificados TLS que protegen las conexiones.
Secrets Manager guarda secretos como contraseñas; AWS recomienda ACM para los certificados y sus llaves privadas.

es.pricingModel: Los certificados SSL/TLS que administras con ACM no tienen cargo adicional; pagas por los recursos de AWS que ejecutan tu sitio o aplicación.

aws: Emite, guarda y renueva certificados para los servicios de AWS integrados
Protege las llaves privadas de los certificados
customer: Demuestra que es dueño o controla cada dominio de un certificado público, con validación por DNS, email o HTTP
Asigna los certificados a los recursos correctos y renueva los importados
